mapper.select: SELECT d.diet_id dietId, d.serve_date serveDate, d.meal_time mealTime, d.planned_menu_id plannedMenuId, d.actual_menu_id actualMenuId, d.is_matched isMatched, NVL(a.menu_name, p.menu_name) menuName, NVL(a.category, p.category) category, p.menu_name plannedMenuName, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_bookmark b WHERE b.userid = #{userid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.menu_id = NVL(d.actual_menu_id, d.planned_menu_id) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END bookmarked FROM tbl_daily_diet d JOIN tbl_menu p ON p.menu_id = d.planned_menu_id LEFT JOIN tbl_menu a ON a.menu_id = d.actual_menu_id WHERE d.serve_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + #{dayOffset} ORDER BY CASE NVL(a.category, p.category) WHEN 'MAIN' THEN 1 WHEN 'SIDE' THEN 2 WHEN 'DESSERT' THEN 3 WHEN 'DRINK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, d.diet_id
